Subject: Vendor security intake: DPA, SOC 2, subprocessor list + PO info

Hi Sarah —

We're getting Guardline queued for procurement onboarding so finance can issue the PO and we can move to contract signature. To close the intake I need the following from you:  

- Fully executed (or signable) DPA (PDF). If you prefer DocuSign, please include a signing link.
- Current SOC 2 report or a hosted read-only link to the report (PDF/HTML).
- Up-to-date subprocessor list (CSV or PDF), ideally indicating region for each subprocessor.
- Preferred billing contact and invoice email, and any vendor tax/VAT number we should include on the PO.

Couple of points to note from our side:
- Our procurement team needs any DPA redlines flagged in-line; minor administrative changes are typically handled by Finance.
- If any subprocessor will process Redwood customer data outside the EU, please call that out explicitly (we have EU data residency requirements for this engagement).

Target timeline: if you can send the materials by EOD Wednesday (21 Oct), I will route to finance and legal for PO and DPA processing with the goal of completing within 5 business days.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Sarah —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments; I downloaded the CSV and skimmed the DPA. A few operational items from Finance / Procurement side to keep the PO flow moving:

1) PO routing: Finance will create the PO once we have the signed DPA and invoice contact confirmed. Please send invoices to accounting@guardline.io and confirm if you require a specific billing address on the PO (we currently have: Guardline Inc., 110 Fleet St, London, EC4A 2AB).

2) PO numbering: our system will assign the PO in this format: RWI-PO-2026-0893. Please reference that number on future invoices once we share it.

3) Data residency clarifier: the CSV indicates two subprocessors with eu_processing_flag = yes. Can you confirm whether either of those subprocessors will process identifiable Redwood customer content (not aggregated telemetry)? That will determine whether we need an Annex for restricted processing.

4) DPA minor ask: section 7 (data retention) — we usually request ability to set retention limits by customer; if that is a non-starter for you, we can mark it as an operational requirement and route through Legal. Please flag your preference so we know whether Legal needs to engage.

If you can confirm the two bullets above (billing address + whether identifiable customer content is processed by the flagged subprocessors), I will push to Finance and Legal today. Goal is to have PO + signed DPA by end of week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
